ruleDefinitions.name: Execution of Suspicious File Type Extension
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects whether the image specified in a process creation event doesn't refer to an ".exe" (or other known executable extension) file. This can be caused by process ghosting or other unorthodox methods to start a process.
This rule might require some initial baselining to align with some third party tooling in the user environment.

sequences.query: NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\\.bin$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\.cgi$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\.com$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\.scr$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\.tmp$"))) AND  NOT ((process_path = "System" OR process_path = "Registry" OR process_path = "MemCompression" OR process_path = "vmmem") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Installer\\\\MSI.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\DriverStore\\\\FileRepository\\\\.*") OR (process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Config\\\.Msi\\\\.*") AND (process_path = RGX("\\\.rbf$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\.rbs$"))) OR (parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*")) OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\\\$Extend\\\\\\$Deleted\\\\.*") OR (process_path = "\-" OR process_path = "") OR process_path = "None") AND  NOT (parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\ProgramData\\\\Avira\\\\.*") OR (process_path = RGX(".*NVIDIA\\\\NvBackend\\\\.*") AND process_path = RGX("\\\.dat$")) OR ((process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\WINPAKPRO\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\WINPAKPRO\\\\.*")) AND process_path = RGX("\\\.ngn$")) OR (process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\MyQ\\\\Server\\\\pcltool\\\.dll$") OR process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\MyQ\\\\Server\\\\pcltool\\\.dll$")) OR (process_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Packages\\\\.*") AND process_path = RGX(".*\\\\LocalState\\\\rootfs\\\\.*")) OR process_path = RGX("\\\\LZMA\\_EXE$") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Mozilla\\ Firefox\\\\.*") OR (parent_process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\services\.exe" AND process_path = RGX("com\\\.docker\\\.service$")))
